summary: Iteration 18: Tested 5 UX improvements — Home hero search-first, /search results page, Course workspace sidebar (LearnChapter), Past Paper Collection page, Individual Past Paper SEO page. Backend: 13/13 pytest tests passed (search API with code detection, past-papers /collection, /page, /paper/{id}, and end-to-end upload→collection→page→search flow). Frontend: 28/31 UI checks passed via Playwright; the 3 unmet checks are non-bugs (data-dependent Practise category, chip-based 'suggested searches' wording, and expected 404 for un-seeded SEO URL).
critical_code_review_comments: past_papers_api.py: parse_cambridge_filename uses re.match which anchors at start. Filenames with any prefix (e.g. 'TEST_0580_s24_qp_22.pdf' or '2024_0580_s24_qp_22.pdf') fail inference silently — resulting doc has empty syllabus_code/subject/year and won't appear in collection/search. Consider re.search or explicit filename normalization.

search_api.py: past-paper code query only detects patterns starting with 4 digits (^\d{4}). A query like 'chemistry 0620' won't hit the is_code_query branch — falls back to general regex which searches title/original_name only, not syllabus_code. Add syllabus_code to the general $or clause.
search_api.py: bson.ObjectId is imported but unused — dead import.
SearchResults.js: empty-query state uses chip buttons but doesn't include descriptive 'Suggested searches' label; consider adding a small heading for a11y/SEO clarity.

past_papers_api.py get_paper_page: session parsing uses str.title() on hyphen-split slugs, which will mangle unknown sessions (e.g. 'winter' → 'Winter' not matching stored value). Rely purely on session_map or return 400 for unknown session slugs.
seed_data_creation: TestPastPaperE2E fixture uploads a dummy 0625_s24_qp_11.pdf during the test class and deletes it in teardown; no persistent seed data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 UX features (hero search, /search page with categories, course workspace sidebar, past paper collection, individual paper SEO page) are working. Public nav now correctly shows Learn | Store | Community | About | Contact + Sign In / Get Started (iter17 open item resolved). Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter18_ux_features.py (13 tests). Known limitation of filename parser: only matches when Cambridge code is at start of filename — flagged in code review but not blocking.
